reward.aimPixels: nearest visible enemy RGB pixel to image center (31.5,17.5); quality 1 within central 2x2, linear falloff to 0 at radius 4
reward.aimEligibility: own actor alive and unprotected throughout decision; enemy protection is not inferred from pixels

training.deployment: deterministic argmax; training samples categorical actions
